title: How the whale evolved
subtitle: 50 million years in 30 seconds
intro: Fifty million years ago, the whale had legs. Watch it happen.
outro: Which one surprised you? Comment below.

shots.name: Pakicetus
shots.label: 50 million years ago
shots.line: A wolf-sized mammal that hunted in shallow rivers
shots.line_voice: Pakicetus. A wolf-sized mammal wading into rivers to hunt.
shots.prompt: Pakicetus, a wolf-sized prehistoric mammal with a long snout and hooved toes, wading in a shallow Eocene river at dawn, reeds and mist

shots.name: Ambulocetus
shots.label: 48 million years ago
shots.line: The walking whale: crocodile-like ambush hunter
shots.line_voice: Ambulocetus, the walking whale. It ambushed prey like a crocodile.
shots.prompt: Ambulocetus natans, a prehistoric semi-aquatic MAMMAL with sleek dark fur, four short webbed legs, a long flat head with small eyes on top, and a long tail, lying half submerged in a muddy estuary like an ambush predator, reeds, warm light

shots.name: Rodhocetus
shots.label: 46 million years ago
shots.line: Legs shrink, tail takes over the swimming
shots.line_voice: Rodhocetus. Its legs shrink, and the tail takes over the swimming.
shots.prompt: Rodhocetus, a prehistoric early whale with a long snout, a furry seal-like body, small webbed hind legs still visible, paddling in clear turquoise coastal water near the surface, sunlight rays

shots.name: Dorudon
shots.label: 40 million years ago
shots.line: Fully marine. Nostrils move up toward a blowhole
shots.line_voice: Dorudon. Fully marine now. The nostrils move up toward a blowhole.
shots.prompt: Dorudon, a five meter long sleek prehistoric whale with tiny vestigial hind limbs, gliding underwater in a deep blue ocean, school of fish

shots.name: Basilosaurus
shots.label: 38 million years ago
shots.line_voice: Basilosaurus. Eighteen meters long, serpent-shaped, the top predator of its sea.
shots.prompt: Basilosaurus, an enormous eighteen meter long serpent-like prehistoric whale, hunting a shark in a dark ancient ocean, dramatic light from above

shots.name: Squalodon
shots.label: 25 million years ago
shots.line_voice: Squalodon. Echolocation appears. It starts hunting by sound.
shots.prompt: Squalodon, a shark-toothed prehistoric dolphin with a long jaw, surfacing in a cold grey ocean, spray and overcast sky

shots.name: Livyatan
shots.label: 12 million years ago
shots.line_voice: Livyatan. A sperm whale cousin with teeth thirty-six centimeters long.
shots.prompt: Livyatan melvillei, a giant prehistoric sperm whale with huge teeth, breaching out of the ocean at sunset, enormous splash

shots.name: Blue whale
shots.label: today
shots.line: The largest animal that has ever lived
shots.line_voice: The blue whale. The largest animal that has ever lived.
shots.prompt: a blue whale, the largest animal ever, swimming majestically under the surface of a sunlit ocean, seen from below, bubbles and light rays
